Prototype 5 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (97%), with EOG (2%) and EMG (1%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+9.5 dB, sensitivity=16.5) and elevated β_h (+0.3 dB, sensitivity=13.8).
The δ activity is present in 90% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 66% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, σ relevant; missing: EOG quiescent.
